issues.title: Petal fleck: core exponent 1.2 dimmed the distance flecks without thinning them close up
issues.evidence: q15 p90/p10 2.8 vs 3.14, fl/gr 2.45 vs 2.70 (w22 3.1 / 2.58 = on target); e4 pad coverage 0.29 vs 0.13 unchanged.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_fleck: exponent back to 1.05; instead thin the flecks - label the excess mask (e > 0.25 ep), drop ~45 % of the components at random with a fixed seed (keep components whose centre is >= 1.5x fleck length from a kept one), and shrink kept cores by a 1-px erosion at tile scale. Targets: e4 pad coverage 0.14-0.18, q15 fl/gr 2.6-2.7, p90/p10 3.0-3.2, coverage 0.20-0.23.

issues.title: Tick: contrast right at row distance, but stroke coverage still ~40 % over and columns wash out on s1
issues.fix: make_swatches.py y_tick: erode the above-median stroke mask by 1 px at tile resolution (or r_hi = m + (r - m) * ((r - m) / (rmax - m)) ** 0.3) so tile coverage(1.4x med) drops ~0.39 -> 0.28, and lift the floor 8 % (r = max(r, 0.55 m) blend) for p10/p50 0.52-0.55; keep band boost 0.1 and the 0.8 stroke factor. Targets: q15 coverage 0.17-0.19 with p90/p10 3.4-3.6 kept; e4 p90/p10 4.0-4.2.
